This pull request is being closed because it still doesn't link an open issue, 8 hours after the first reminder.

To reopen it, edit the PR description to link an open issue that you are assigned to (for example, `Fixes #123`). The pull request is reopened automatically once the link is in place.

If there's no issue yet, open one, comment on it to ask to work on it, and wait for a maintainer to assign it to you. See [Issues before PRs](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#issues-before-prs) in the contribution guidelines.
